setting.Layout.Mode.description: How the fixed crates, baskets and other blockers on the boat deck are chosen. Parcels that arrive with the boat never change. The sections below only work in their own mode.
setting.GameVariants.Allowed.description: Numbers of the game boat variants that may come, for example 1,2,4. Empty means all. Each variant keeps its own blockers and its own arriving parcels. Works in the Game layouts mode.
setting.GameVariants.AvoidRepeats.description: The same variant never comes twice in a row. Works in the Game layouts mode.
setting.FixedVariant.Variant.description: The game boat variant that comes every time, with its own blockers and arriving parcels. If a level has fewer variants, its last one is used. Works in the One game layout mode.
setting.Height.ApprovedHeightScale.description: Multiplier for the height above which a stack on the boat turns red. 1 keeps the game value.
setting.Height.MaximumHeightScale.description: Multiplier for the absolute height limit of stacks on the boat. The approved height never exceeds it.
setting.CustomLayouts.Order.description: How own layouts are picked: at random, one after another by file name, or always one file. Works in the Own layouts and Mixed modes.
setting.CustomLayouts.File.description: Name of the layout file used when the order is Always one file, for example deck_20260925_215809. Works in the Own layouts mode.
setting.CustomLayouts.AvoidRepeats.description: The same own layout never comes twice in a row when picked at random.
setting.Generated.Density.description: Share of the deck taken by generated blockers. Works in the Generated and Mixed modes.
setting.Generated.EdgesOnly.description: Generated blockers stay near the rails, like in the game, and keep the middle of the deck free.
setting.Mixed.GameWeight.description: Chance weight of the game deck in the Mixed mode.
setting.Mixed.EmptyWeight.description: Chance weight of an empty deck in the Mixed mode.
setting.Mixed.CustomWeight.description: Chance weight of own layouts in the Mixed mode. Ignored when there are none.
setting.Mixed.GeneratedWeight.description: Chance weight of a generated deck in the Mixed mode.
setting.Saving.SaveHotkey.description: Saves the deck of the boat at the dock as an own layout. Cells of the parcels that arrived with this boat are left out; every other taken cell is saved, so take off the parcels you do not want in it.

message.noBoat: No boat at the dock to save
